system.description:
Technical drones are heavier than others because they include robotic arms with integrated tools and advanced stabilization systems that allow operators to perform repairs and other “hands-on” technical tasks. This usually equates to having all the lightweight basic tools required to perform tasks associated with one or two ability focuses, such as Intelligence (Medicine) or Dexterity (Crafts) with Intelligence (Tinkering). A direct tactile or neural interface avoids any penalties for remote use. The arms have a Strength of 1.

Speed/Velocity: Fast/-2. Armor Rating: 4/4. Health: 40. Automation: Standard.
